answer: Weight comes only from root distance on the ivory ledger, where auditors recompute edges. Only a mirror edge counts, signed by both ends. A spiral decay sets weight: one hop full, two half, three a quarter, past three zero. Each identity locks a 60-credit bond. A sponsor takes at most three newcomers per epoch, at 20, 40, 80 credits. The k-th fake pays 60 plus its step fee, then needs a new sponsor. 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors, 60,000 bonds, 46,640 fees. Rented endorsements fail: a mirror edge sold twice shares one path, and auditors slash the bond. Honest agents pay one bond plus 20.
